supported_mechanisms.capability: Beds24 can redirect the guest after the booking confirmation step to a first-party AUMARA URL and append booking information to that URL.
Beds24 Auto Actions can run webhooks or HTTP POST notifications using booking trigger conditions and template variables.
supported_mechanisms.timing_note: Auto Actions are batch processed and are not a strict real-time browser signal.

recommended_contract.browser_return: Use Booking Return URL for first-party attribution continuity after successful direct booking.
recommended_contract.server_signal: Use a Beds24 Auto Action webhook as the authoritative validation/reconciliation signal when configured.
recommended_contract.privacy: Do not send guest name, email, phone or other direct identifiers to Google Ads/GA4 conversion events.

release_gate: Configure one supported Beds24 completion path with confirmed-booking semantics.
Create or resolve a completed-booking Google Ads conversion action, or resolve an already-linked GA4 key event.
Prove one real successful direct booking end-to-end with transaction deduplication before enabling conversion-based bidding.
